subject: MPA: Security decision path and acceptance criteria for LumenBank
messages:
From: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@lumenbank.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: legal@lumenbank.com
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff — security gating questions

Hi Lukas / Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We want to lock the mutual action plan this week so we can schedule an internal risk review next Tuesday. Before we commit, two gating questions from risk and legal:

1) SOC 2: can you confirm when the latest SOC 2 Type II report will be available to us and whether it will cover hosted API operations?
2) SIG/CAIQ: do you have a completed SIG questionnaire or a CAIQ summary we can review?
3) DPA & retention: we've attached our standard DPA; are there any carve-outs Redwood needs, and can you confirm data retention window options for customer tokens/embeddings?

If we can get those answered with a proposed acceptance timeline, we can move to the formal MAP sign-off.

Appreciate it — cc'ing Jacob from legal for DPA redline.

Best,
Aisha
Senior Security Program Manager
LumenBank
[Attachment: LumenBank_DPA_Template.pdf (PDF, 185KB)]

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@lumenbank.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, legal@lumenbank.com
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff — security gating questions

Hi Aisha — thanks, great questions. Draft responses below and a proposed acceptance path attached.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a rolling SOC 2 Type II covering hosted API controls. We can provide the most recent report for review by EOD Friday (2027-05-07). It covers API access, change control, and incident response for hosted endpoints.
- SIG/CAIQ: We have a completed SIG Lite export and a CAIQ summary; I attached a CSV (SIG_POAM.csv) and a short roadmap PDF (MPA_Security_Roadmap_v2.pdf).
- DPA & retention: We reviewed the LumenBank template and have one standard request: a limited data-subject retention carve (customer embeddings/plaintext request logs) and an option for EU residency. We'll propose retention windows in the MAP below.

Proposed MAP acceptance path (high-level):
1) Evidence intake (by 2027-05-07): SOC 2 report delivery + SIG/CAIQ export + architecture diagram.
2) Risk review (by 2027-05-11): LumenBank security team validates evidence and flags items.
3) DPA negotiation (target DocuSign by 2027-05-14): legal to exchange redlines; Redwood requests limited retention options (30 / 90 / 365 days) plus an escrow option for long-term archives.
4) Final acceptance (by 2027-05-21): Sign-off condition: either (a) SOC 2 in place + SIG items closed, or (b) agreed compensating controls and DPA signed.

Open asks for LumenBank:
- Legal: please confirm any non-starters in the DPA redline (cc Jacob).
- Security: confirm the acceptance window you need and whether a 30-day short-window is acceptable for POC.

Attachments: MPA_Security_Roadmap_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB); SIG_POAM.csv (CSV, 28KB).

If helpful, Kim (cc) can lead the DPA carve conversation.

Thanks — Lukas
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MPA_Security_Roadmap_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)] [Attachment: SIG_POAM.csv (CSV, 28KB)]

From: Jacob Reed <jacob.reed@lumenbank.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.com, aisha.morgan@lumenbank.com
Cc: legal@lumenbank.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff — DPA redline and retention clarification

Lukas / Aisha / Team,

I've uploaded a redline of the DPA with two primary asks:
- Data residency: we prefer EU residency for EU-origin customers; if Redwood cannot guarantee, we need contractual controls.
- Retention: for PII-derived artifacts we require a maximum of 90 days unless explicitly agreed for archival.

DocuSign link (redline): https://docusign.com/LumenBank-DPA-Redline-12345

A few clarifying notes:
- We noted a section in your MAP doc that mentions a 30/90/365 tiering. Can Redwood confirm whether shorter retention (30 days) is available for POC traffic?
- Please flag any keystore/KMS questions — our security team will need to evaluate key custody.

Thanks,
Jacob Reed
Sr. Counsel (Privacy & Security)
LumenBank
[Attachment: LumenBank_DPA_Redline.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jacob Reed <jacob.reed@lumenbank.com>, aisha.morgan@lumenbank.com
Cc: lukas.meyer@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff — DPA redline and retention clarification

Jacob / Aisha — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2 timing: we will deliver the most recent SOC 2 Type II report by EOD 2027-05-07 as promised (covering hosted API controls). If you want a bridge letter specific to your assessment scope, we can provide one by 2027-05-12.
- Retention tiers: for POC / sandbox traffic we can enable a 30-day retention setting. For production we support 90-day and an optional 365-day archival with customer-managed encryption keys as an add-on.
- EU residency: Redwood offers a regional-hosted option (EU region) under Redwood Private or Dedicated; for hosted API customers we can route european-only traffic to EU-backed instances — we'll include that as a contractable option.

I've attached a short instructions doc for SOC2 delivery and the recommended evidence bundle for your risk team to review. For the DPA redline: Kim, can you take point? Once legal hits back with DocuSign we can agree target sign date.

Thanks — Neha
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_Report_Delivery_Instructions.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@lumenbank.com>, Jacob Reed <jacob.reed@lumenbank.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff — security gating questions / MAP acceptance path (final)

Aisha / Jacob — looping back with final mutual action items and timeline so we can lock the MAP today: 

Mutual Action Items (owner — due):
- Redwood: deliver SOC 2 Type II report + evidence bundle (Neha) — due 2027-05-07 (delivered)
- LumenBank: risk review feedback (Aisha) — due 2027-05-11
- Redwood Legal / LumenBank Legal: finalize DPA redline in DocuSign (Kim / Jacob) — target 2027-05-14
- Redwood: enable POC retention toggles (30/90) and provide KMS options doc (Neha) — due 2027-05-12
- Both: final sign-off and go/no-go on production (Sales + Security) — target 2027-05-21

Acceptance criteria (conditions for MAP close):
1) SOC 2 report provided and no critical control gaps open, AND
2) DPA executed with agreed retention window (one of 30/90/365) or compensating controls documented, AND
3) SIG POAM items with security severity > medium are triaged with timelines in the POAM.

A couple of clarifying points:
- Quoting Jacob: "we prefer EU residency for EU-origin customers" — available as an opt-in contract clause; we'll note costs and lead time in the MAP addendum.
- For POC we will enable the 30-day retention toggle today once the POAM and DPA guardrails are agreed.

Next steps: Kim will coordinate legal redline exchange; Neha will upload the SOC2 evidence bundle to the shared drive and post the link; Lukas will update the MPA_Security_Roadmap_v2 with the final targets and circulate for signature.

If there are no objections, we'll convert this thread into the formal mutual action plan doc and share the DocuSign envelope by Thursday.

Thanks,
Lukas
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
